summary: Some sad truths told in Genesis, yet Lot, so named for his theoxenia, Angels welcomed only by "Lot's wife" who served food wine, and life her angles promised to strangers left as pillar of salt a bitter reward for glancing at home #poetryport #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Some sad
truths told
in Genesis,
yet Lot, so named
for his theoxenia,
Angels welcomed
only by "Lot's wife"
who served food
wine, and life
her angles promised
to strangers
left as pillar of salt
a bitter reward for
glancing at home
